Prince Harry Discusses Ukraine Support and Military Service

Prince Harry has stated there is a "big separation" between the U.S. administration and the public regarding support for Ukraine. In a separate discussion, he indicated he would rejoin the army to fight against Russia. His uncle, Earl Spencer, revealed that Prince Harry had pleaded with him over his memoir. Separately, The Daily Telegraph suggested Prince Harry deserves public backing if he pursues a path of service.
